about: Contracts, generated at random in the garage (src/game/missions.js). Each has one goal from `goals` with targets drawn from its ranges and sized to the trail being played and to the trucks owned, may be locked to a class or to one owned truck (`locks`), and may carry 0 to 2 `twists` (extra rules). XP is MISSION_BASE_XP (src/game-config.js) times (the goal's difficulty, 0.6 to 1.8, plus each twist's `xp` share and the lock's), rounded to 10 and worked out live, so changing the base changes every contract on offer; class-locked contracts also scale by the class (XP_BY_CLASS). One offer is always a depot contract for the class driven least. Offers not chosen are redrawn after every run; the chosen one stays until done. Failing costs nothing.

featured.about: One hand-written contract per map is always on offer while that map is chosen (src/game/missions.js). `goal` and `twists` use the same kinds as above; targets are still sized to the trail. Each pays `xp` times a normal contract of its difficulty and `coins` on top.

swamp-summer.title: Bayou Doctor
swamp-summer.story: Insulin for the stilt houses past the gator crossing. Keep it cool and keep it moving.

swamp-summer.title: Gator Alley
swamp-summer.story: The crew needs to know the bogs are passable before the levee closes. Prove it.

spring-thaw.title: Snowmelt Express
spring-thaw.story: The pass opens for one afternoon before the next storm. Beat the melt.

spring-thaw.title: Washout Watch
spring-thaw.story: Flash the radar so they know the highway is open again.

autumn-forest.title: Last Load Before Frost
autumn-forest.story: The mill shuts for winter at sundown. Every log that makes it gets paid.

autumn-forest.title: Ridge Runner
autumn-forest.story: Clear the deadfall and rock off the logging road before the leaf-peepers arrive.

desert-wash.title: Canyon Water Run
desert-wash.story: The well pump died. Get there before the heat of the day, and don't stop for fuel.

desert-wash.title: Mirage Speedway
desert-wash.story: The canyon cameras are the only timing gear out here. Make them blink.

gumbo-bottoms.title: River Rising
gumbo-bottoms.story: Sandbags and pumps for the levee. The water is coming up a foot an hour.

gumbo-bottoms.title: Gumbo King
gumbo-bottoms.story: Nobody has run the whole bottoms without a tow this season. Be the first.

highland-quarry.title: Slate for the Chapel
highland-quarry.story: Hand-split roof slate for a 300-year-old chapel. Not one cracked tile.

highland-quarry.title: Blast Clearance
highland-quarry.story: Shot rock all over the haul road. Clear it before the next shift.

jungle-monsoon.title: Before the Flood
jungle-monsoon.story: Generators and medicine for the station. The monsoon breaks the road in hours.

jungle-monsoon.title: Thunder Run
jungle-monsoon.story: Lightning has the cameras flickering. Get clocked before they go down.

volcanic-ash.title: Ash Fall Evacuation
volcanic-ash.story: The crater is rumbling. Get the last supplies out to the shelter, fast and in one piece.

volcanic-ash.title: Lava Field Sprint
volcanic-ash.story: Fresh sensors for the rim station. Reach the checkpoint before the next eruption window.

signature.about: Every truck has a signature haul on its home map: its own load (or, empty, a run of the whole trail) for a named client. Homes are worked out in src/game/missions.js from each map's `likes` (words in the load's name and the truck's biomes), spread so every map gets its share, and free starters stay on free maps. Shown when that truck is chosen on its home map; the first completion pays `coins` times the truck's price share and `xp` times a normal contract; later ones pay like any contract.

load: {client} needs the {load} today, and nobody else will drive the {map} trail for it.
Word is the {load} can't go by any other road. {client} is counting on your {truck}.
{client} pays double if the {load} gets there with nothing broken.
empty: {client} wants to know the {map} trail is open. Run the whole thing in your {truck}.
Scout the {map} trail end to end for {client}. Your {truck} is the only one fit for it.
